thread:
incident-bot: Pager: cont-batching latency spike + KV-cache memory growth on rtf-gpu-prod cluster (severity: P1). Affected pods > 20% across nodepool-a. AlertID: RBW-3891.

mike_oncall: taking this. pinging SRE + runtime. seeing queue depth jump on actor-frontend, microbatch sizes ~12-20 (target is 4). KV cache size trending up fast, evictions skyrocketing.

sara_eng: noted. recent rollout of prefetch heuristic change (PR: 5123) went out 22:10 UTC. Could be prefetch + high concurrency -> cache blowout.

ben_sre: confirmable. memory pressure + GC cycles correlated with KV cache growth. Suggest immediate mitigation: 1) set microbatch_max=4, microbatch_target=2 on serving-config 2) temp disable prefetch for affected model family 3) apply soft rate limit on tenant routes. low-risk hotpatch.

mike_oncall: doing step 1 now — patching configmap and triggering rolling-restart for frontend-svc subset. cmd: ```kubectl -n rtf patch configmap serving-config --patch '{"data":{"microbatch_max":"4","microbatch_target":"2"}}'```

sara_eng: I'll open a canary rollback for PR 5123 and flip prefetch off for canary traffic. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/5123 (rollback flag "prefetch.enabled=false").

jordan_support: heads-up — Support sees increased 502s from 3 paying tenants (acct ids redacted). Escalating to CSMs, ETA for outreach ~15m.

incident-bot: Action logged: oncall=mike_oncall, severity=P1, team=eng-runtime.

mike_oncall: microbatch patch applied to nodepool-a (15 pods). rolling restarts in progress. cpu/mem showing small spike during restarts. monitoring helm release for errors.

ben_sre: applying eviction tuning on KV cache to more aggressive LRU thresholds while we triage: `kvcache.eviction_threshold=0.7` -> apply via runtime flag on gateway. Doing it now.

sara_eng: prefetched disabled on canary (10% traffic). initial metrics: KV-cache insert rate dropped ~60% for canary. latency improved in canary from p95 2.8s -> 1.1s.

mike_oncall: after microbatch change + eviction tuning: queue depth down ~70% on patched pods, p95 latency down to 1.3s cluster-wide for patched subset. errors dropping. still seeing heavier tail on unpatched pods.

jordan_support: support notified customers 3 tenants, initial message sent. one tenant reported increased inference latency causing UI timeouts; they're on dedicated capacity but traffic went through shared gateway during burst.

sara_eng: prepping hotpatch PR to make microbatch defaults safer and add a runtime flag to disable prefetch per-tenant. PR draft 5130. snippet of change: ```diff --serving/config
- microbatch_target: 8
+ microbatch_target: 2 # temporary safer default under high concurrency
+ prefetch:
+   enabled: false # opt-in prefetch instead of default-on
```

ben_sre: suggest also adding a short-circuit: if KV-cache growth rate > X over 1m, auto-disable prefetch for that model family. Could avoid future manual ops.

mike_oncall: agreed. for now we need cluster-wide rollout of the hotpatch to stop further regression. rolling patch to remaining nodepools now.

incident-bot: Deployment event: rollout start by mike_oncall @ 1712349988.

sara_eng: hotpatch rolled to remaining nodepools by 1712350300. metrics: evictions down, insert rate stabilized. global p95 latency returned to baseline ~0.9s. error rate back to normal for 2/3 tenants; one tenant still shows intermittent 502s — investigating path via logs.

mike_oncall: root cause hypothesis: prefetch heuristic was overly aggressive at high concurrency, causing repeated cache churn and oversized microbatches due to scheduler grouping heuristics. Combined effect -> KV cache blowout and queuing.

jordan_support: customer update: tenant A saw degraded experience for ~18m, tenant B ~12m, tenant C ~9m. All have been notified; CSMs are on follow-up calls.

elaine_prod: thanks team. please open a postmortem ticket and include timeline + config diffs + mitigation steps. Also add runbook change: under high concurrency, default prefetch must be off and a canary flag required to enable.

ben_sre: I'll file infra ticket to propose the auto-disable heuristics and add metric alarm for KV-cache growth rate. Ticket: INFRA-870.

sara_eng: created hotpatch PR 5130 (draft -> ready) and hotfix rollout log: https://console.redwood-inference/sr/rollouts/7845. Please review when available.

mike_oncall: closing pager, switching to postmortem mode. Final notes: mitigation = microbatch cap down + disable prefetch + eviction tuning + temporary per-tenant rate limits. Customer impact tracked. Follow-up owners: sara_eng (runtime fix + PR), ben_sre (infra alarm + eviction defaults), elaine_prod (customer comms).

incident-bot: Pager resolved by mike_oncall @ 1712350600. Incident duration ~11m. Severity downgraded to P2 for postmortem.

jordan_support: adding affected tenant list to incident ticket and handing to CSMs.

mike_oncall: quick postmortem items: 1) Add KV-cache growth alarm (rate & absolute), 2) make prefetch opt-in, 3) adjust microbatch autoscaling heuristics to avoid aggressive grouping, 4) run e2e perf test at high concurrency with prefetch toggled. I'll own follow-ups in the ticket. :thumbsup:

elaine_prod: good work. let's aim for a public-notification draft for enterprise customers tomorrow if needed.

sara_eng: also scheduling a small load-test against canary with synthetic tenant traffic to validate the auto-disable logic next week.

mike_oncall: thx all. handing off to follow-ups.
